title: Adaptive attention routing multimodal expert graph neural network for drug-drug interaction prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.33200v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate prediction of drug-drug interactions (DDIs) is essential for drug safety in combination therapy. Multimodal methods built on knowledge graphs (KGs) already combine molecular structures, substructures, targets and biomedical relations into drug representations, but they still face three problems: features are heterogeneous across modalities, fusion does not adapt to individual drug pairs, and modality-specific information is diluted during integration. We propose the adaptive attention routing multimodal expert graph neural network (AARME-GNN) to address them. A Feature Adaptive Calibration Module (FACM) reduces within-modality noise in each representation through bottleneck reparameterization and channelwise recalibration before fusion. A Multimodal Weight Router (MMWR) then sets the modality weights of each drug pair, with an entropy constraint that prevents the weights from collapsing onto one modality. A Routing-Aware Weigh

translated_title: 用于药物-药物相互作用预测的自适应注意力路由多模态专家图神经网络
translated_abstract: 准确预测药物-药物相互作用（DDIs）对于联合治疗中的用药安全至关重要。基于知识图谱（KGs）的多模态方法已经将分子结构、子结构、靶点和生物医学关系融合到药物表示中，但仍面临三个问题：各模态间的特征是异构的、融合过程无法针对单个药物对自适应调整、以及模态特异性信息在整合过程中被稀释。我们提出自适应注意力路由多模态专家图神经网络（AARME-GNN）来解决这些问题。特征自适应校准模块（FACM）在融合之前通过瓶颈重参数化和通道级重校准来降低每种表示中的模态内噪声。多模态权重路由器（MMWR）随后为每个药物对设定模态权重，并通过熵约束防止权重坍缩到单一模态上。路由感知加权……
tldr: 提出自适应注意力路由多模态专家图神经网络（AARME-GNN），通过特征自适应校准模块与带熵约束的多模态权重路由器，解决药物相互作用预测中多模态特征异构、融合不适应药物对及模态信息被稀释的问题。
en_tdlr: AARME-GNN tackles drug-drug interaction prediction by combining a Feature Adaptive Calibration Module to reduce within-modality noise and a Multimodal Weight Router with entropy constraint to adaptively weight modalities for each drug pair, addressing feature heterogeneity and modality dilution in multimodal fusion.
